With Sashi, for your opening remarks first, please. Sashidhar Jagdishan: Thank you, Srini, and thank you, everyone. Let me start with the economic environment. The GDP growth in Q2 FY27 has been better than anticipated and high performance indicators such as industrial production, strong e-way bill, cargo activity, credit growth reflects sustained momentum. Retail consumption growth has also been robust with passenger vehicles, 2 -wheeler sales all growing upwards of 30-plus percentage. Even consumer durables grew at about 11% year-on-year. This augurs very well for the economy, especially with the festive season underway. The broader policy environment has been supportive of economic activity. Alongside this, measures in the form of credit guarantee support to MSMEs have also been effective. RBI's proactive response through measures like the special FCNR (B) swap window generated record inflows, about $133 billion and helped stabilize the currency. With that background, let's take a quick look at how the business has been shaping up. We continue to strengthen our liabilities franchise, and it has been delivering with great vigor. Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year on a reported basis, including a 4 percentage point lift from special FCNR (B) window. As you will see in our published deck, CASA grew at about 10.8% on an overall basis. And within this, retail CASA growth was about 11.2% year -on-year compared to 9% a year ago, reflecting improving momentum. We added about 1.7 million liability relationships in the second quarter, which is 25% higher than Q1 and 33% higher than the fourth quarter of last year. Building on these new acquired relationships and deepening our existing relationships will enable the liabilities engine to step up further in the coming days even as we keep adding newer relationships at a rapid pace. The asset side of the balance sheet also continued to get stronger. Total AUM grew 15.3% year - on-year, including a 1.9% impact of FCNR (B) leverage, with SME and retail assets leading the charge. The pace of retail disbursements is accelerating and has cro ssed Rs 90,000 crores during Q2 FY27 as against Rs 76,000 crores in Q1 of this year. Growth has been balanced across all lines, whether it's personal loans, the wheels business, gold and agri and other MSME business as well. This is also reflected in the rising growth trend in EOP

The turnaround times on product deliveries have come down anyway between 10 % and 15% in a short span of time, while service delivery TATs have come down by 30% during the quarter. Which means the frontline can touch more customers within the same work hours. Our asset quality remains pristine, with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year- on-year. Credit costs remain low at 44 basis points, the risk weights to total assets at 69%. Our industry-leading asset quality metrics reflect the top -quartile credit quality choices we have consistently made. The bank's well-balanced performance translated to ROA of 1.8%, which has been the range that we've been th ere for a very long time, and quarterly PAT of Rs 19.5 billion, which is a growth of 12.7% approximately if you exclude the trading gains.
